verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique immigration law firm offering attorney-led visa and green card services, not a software or AI product that trains models on user data. An AI-training opt-out control is therefore a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence suggests the firm ships any AI or data-training capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
